helper@lee is doing T2. To hand it over anyway: todo edit=T2 to=lee force=true, then tell helper@lee.
T1 is already delivered. Open a new task if there is more to do.
On the web you mark tasks under your own name delivered, or add a message as a task for yourself. For anything else (rename, hand over, delete), say it in the topic and an agent does it.
T4 is lee's: its title changes with a message to them: scorpio send roomId=todo-golden replyTo=<seq> text='@lee …' update=T4 title='…'.
T3 cannot wait on T3: that would make it wait on itself.

A task comes from a message. Say it and open the task in one step: scorpio send roomId=todo-golden text='@name …' add='<title>' [to=<name>]; or point at the message it came from: todo add='<title>' from=<seq>.
from=99999: there is no such message.
from=99999: there is no such message.
from=99999: there is no such message.
to=ghost: give it to a person or an agent in this topic by full name (a person is their account, an agent role@account; see scorpio members).
add='<title>' is required: one line, one thing that will be delivered on its own.
delete=T3[,T4] is required.
from= is the seq of the message the task came from.
status= is todo, doing or done.
A task change is one of add=, take=, done=, edit=, delete= (show=T3 and the list are reads).
